integrity: Analytical proof and standalone deterministic quadrature are supplied; no claim of experimental or independently audited certification.
scientific_limitations: Finite classical single-domain-wall Gibbs sector; independent symmetric strictly log-concave field-energy increments; strictly positive inverse temperature and nonzero disorder. Does not address multi-wall configurations, coherent dynamics or correlated field noise. Prior qualitative U-shape and perturbative/limiting results are credited. The 2022 supplementary material was not fully inspected and implicit coverage remains a scientific priority risk.
title: All-temperature strict boundary bias in disordered single-wall Ising chains
